notes: Monthly views of the participants stores (scripts/participants_report.py). Aggregation: mean = average per day of the month, sum = month total, last = month end.
Market Pulse categories are aliased across editions (FPI → Foreign Investors, DII → DIIs, PRO → Prop, Individual investors → Individuals).

nse_fo_vol.heading: NSE F&O traded contracts, long + short, daily average

nse_fo_oi.heading: NSE F&O open interest, long + short, average day

bse_fo_vol.heading: BSE F&O traded contracts, long + short, daily average

bse_fo_oi.heading: BSE F&O open interest, long + short, average day

nse_cm_cat_gross.heading: NSE cash market turnover (buy + sell) by client category, daily average

nse_cm_cat_net.heading: NSE cash market net buying (buy − sell) by client category, month total

nse_fo_cat_gross.heading: NSE F&O turnover (buy + sell; options on premium) by client category, daily average

bse_fo_cat_gross.heading: BSE F&O turnover (buy + sell, notional) by category, daily average

nse_fii_fo_gross.heading: NSE FII derivatives turnover (buy + sell value), daily average

nse_fii_fo_oi.heading: NSE FII derivatives open interest value, month end

nsdl_fpi_net.heading: FPI net investment by asset class (NSDL), month total

nsdl_fpi_gross.heading: FPI gross purchases + sales by asset class (NSDL), daily average

nse_fiidii_net.heading: FII/FPI and DII net, provisional (NSE + BSE + MSEI), month total

bse_cash_cat_gross.heading: BSE cash market purchase + sale by client type, daily average
